chapter.heading: Psalm 60
He Will Tread Down Our Foes

To the choirmaster: according to Shushan Eduth. A Miktam(1) of David; for instruction; when he strove with Aram-naharaim and with Aram-zobah, and when Joab on his return struck down twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt.
chapter.v: you have been angry ;oh , restore us .
repair its breaches , for it totters .
you have given uswine to drink that made us stagger .
that they may flee to itfrom the bow . Selah
give salvation by your right hand and answer us !
and portion out the Vale ofSuccoth .
Who will lead me to Edom ?
Youdo not go forth , O God , with our armies .
forvain is the salvation of man !
it is he who willtread down our foes .
